औत्स a. (त्सी f.) [उत्स-अञ्]
Born or produced in a fountain.

औत्संगिक a. (की f.) [
उत्संगठक्] Borne or placed upon the hip.

औत्सर्गिक a. (की f.) [
[]
उत्सर्गष्ठञ्]
1 That which is liable to be
abolished in exceptional cases,
though generally valid (as a rule
of grammar).
--2 General (opp. to
particular), not restricted
--3
Terminating, concluding.
--4 Leaving,
quitting.
--5 Natural, inherent.
--6 Produced naturally or directly.
--7 Derivative.

औत्सुक्यं [उत्सुक-ष्यञ्]
1 Anxiety,
uneasiness.
--2 Ardent desire,
eagerness, zeal; औत्सुक्यपात्रनवसादयति
प्रतिष्ठा Ś. 5. 6; औत्सुक्येत कृतत्वरा
सहभुवा व्यावर्तमाना ह्रिया
